# 太霄琅書瓊文帝章訣-六朝

**ID:** KR5a0130
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0130

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-folio Six-Dynasties Shàngqīng scripture identical to juan 5 of *[DZ 1332 Dòngzhēn tàishàng tàixiāo lángshū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1332)*, containing prescriptions for the copying of sacred scriptures and rules pertaining to the gifts to be offered by the disciple at the time of transmission of the scriptures, together with various other ritual prescriptions. This text and [DZ 55](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0055) correspond to number 30 of the *Shàngqīng dàdòng zhēnjīng mù* 上清大洞真經目.

**Abstract**

Isabelle Robinet, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 1:181 (§1.B.2, Shàngqīng), dates the text to the Six Dynasties and identifies it as the *jué* (ritual-formula) companion to [DZ 55](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0055). The frontmatter brackets composition notBefore 420 / notAfter 589, with dynasty 六朝. No author is attributed.
